data.question: Berapa tingkat pengangguran terbuka di Maluku tahun 2025?

value.raw_question: Berapa tingkat pengangguran terbuka di Maluku tahun 2025?

value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, MAX(nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.kode
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.nilai AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode
AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0);

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    nilai_indikator.periode AS periode,
    nilai_indikator.nilai AS tingkat_pengangguran
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
LEFT JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0);

SELECT DISTINCT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.periode AS periode, AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, nilai_indikator.periode;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.nilai AS periode, SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, nilai_indikator.nilai;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    nilai_indikator.periode AS periode,
    MAX(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM
    nilai_indikator
JOIN
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.nama, nilai_indikator.periode
ORDER BY
    nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.nilai AS nilai FROM provinsi INNER JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0) ORDER BY nilai DESC LIMIT 1;
